title: lavandula pedunculata subsp. atlantica
intro: Lavandula pedunculata subsp. atlantica, commonly known as Spanish lavender, is a subspecies of lavender plant native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant is valued for its calming and sedative properties, which can provide relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness. The health benefits of Spanish lavender include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve sleep quality, and alleviate digestive issues. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including linalool, linalyl acetate, and camphor, which have been shown to have anxiolytic, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
